pr_title: Filter out possibly stuck relocations on SearchableSnapshotsRelocationIntegTests.testRelocationWaitsForPreWarm

review_comment: I am not sure I follow this, how do we run into not having enough space available in this test?

The cache size is set randomly in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/36683a4581a8fc2f108701d92af2e4d527e56d02/x-pack/plugin/searchable-snapshots/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/searchablesnapshots/BaseSearchableSnapshotsIntegTestCase.java#L53 and in some cases it's too small to hold all the data.
